name: us4-reinstall-preserves-config
description: FR-020: a committed config.yml and a gitignored config.local.yml survive an extension invocation byte-for-byte. Reinstalling/upgrading the extension is only a file copy; no script path may touch .specify/jira/. Here a benign `config --help` invocation runs on both ports; the post-run repository tree is diffed for port parity, and the two config layers must be byte-identical to the fixture originals (asserted by tests/bash/conformance/test_us4_preserve.bats). Once the config command lands (US1) this scenario also covers the full re-run path.
